# Glyph block font_glyph_block_1, written by tools/osd_gen.py; see docs/OSD-TEXT.md.
# Its record (font_glyph_block_1, RAM 0xA80240B0, flash 0xEC0B0 in the start values) holds the packed size, the
# kind, the destination address in the menu layer memory and the address of the data. The record
# lies outside the menu area, so the data keeps its address and its packed size (6556 bytes).
# The data is sent run-length packed (osd_ram_write_packed_block): a 0x00 or 0xFF byte is
# followed by a repeat count. The build packs the bytes below again.
block font_glyph_block_1
data 0x118A38
record 0xA80240B0
packed 6556
kind 3   # command 0xC1, destination 0x3F

# 23328 bytes after unpacking, 27 per line. The layout of this kind of block in the layer memory is
# not shown by the code, so the bytes are given as they are sent.
